comparisonPolicy: All four models use the same spacecraft timestamps and a shared positive finite mask for each quantity. The three reconstructions used spacecraft data in calibration; the archived CCMC run is a remote-driven comparator. These residuals alone do not measure independent forecasting skill.
densityConvention: ENLIL archive N is mass density divided by proton mass. With nα/np = 0.05, np = N / 1.2. Density and proton flux use this correction; speed is the full heliocentric velocity magnitude.
earthProxy: The archived Earth trajectory represents the near-Earth comparison to Wind. It is not the exact Wind trajectory.

spacecraft.label: STEREO-A / PLASTIC
spacecraft.qualification: The models are compared with spacecraft measurements on the same finite hourly samples, 19 Nov–5 Dec 2025. Argon and Claude assimilated these spacecraft; Codex also used spacecraft data in calibration. These residuals therefore include calibration performance. Ratios give model / observation.

comet.clock: Photon-arrival UTC at the geometric Earth proxy
comet.convention: This table and these curves compare heliocentric proton flux np|v| for every model. The X-ray section instead uses comet-relative incident flux np|v−vcomet|. Means use exact native piecewise-linear integration over the same accepted PN intervals on the photon-arrival clock.

limitations.title: Input maps and prescribed transients
limitations.body: Coronal-map uncertainty and approximate cone directions, widths and speeds affect the propagated wind. A cone does not recover the full asymmetric structure of an eruption.

limitations.title: Resolution and sampling
limitations.body: This archived run uses 90 longitude and 24 latitude cells. Narrow structures and their arrival times remain sensitive to numerical and boundary choices. A low residual in one sampled sector does not establish the wind at the comet.

limitations.title: Agreement is not validation
limitations.body: ENLIL is another modeled reconstruction. Matching it tests consistency; spacecraft residuals test the sampled plasma. The calibrated agent runs and the remote-driven reference have different information available.

limitations.title: No absolute X-ray prediction
limitations.body: These plasma fields do not supply the neutral coma, emitting-ion charge states, charge-exchange yields or instrument response needed to predict the EPIC-pn count rate.
